107:### Combat & Equipment
116:| `async attack(target: CombatTarget, timeout: number = 5000): Promise<AttackResult>` | Attack an NPC or another player, walking to the target if needed. Takes either an entity (from `sdk.findNearbyNpc`/`sdk.findNearbyPlayer`) or a name/pattern, matched against NPCs first and players second - so pass the entity when a player shares a name with a monster. ```ts await bot.attack(/^chicken$/i); await bot.attack(sdk.findNearbyPlayer('Zezima')!); ``` PvP attacks are refused outside the wilderness and across too big a level gap; those come back as `reason: 'not_attackable'` with the server's own wording in `message`. |
117:| `async attackPlayer(target: NearbyPlayer \| string \| RegExp, timeout: number = 5000): Promise<AttackResult>` | Attack another player (OPPLAYER2). Prefer {@link attack}, which also takes NPCs. |
118:| `async castSpell(target: CombatTarget, spellComponent: number \| string, timeout: number = 3000): Promise<CastSpellResult>` | Cast a combat spell on an NPC or another player. The two are the same action to the server (OPNPCT vs OPPLAYERT), so this takes either: an entity from `sdk.findNearbyNpc`/`sdk.findNearbyPlayer`, or a name/pattern matched against NPCs first and players second. ```ts await bot.castSpell('goblin', Spells.WIND_STRIKE); await bot.castSpell(sdk.findNearbyPlayer('Zezima')!, Spells.FIRE_STRIKE); ``` Magic XP is the evidence of a cast landing, so a splash still counts as success with `hit: false`. |
119:| `async castSpellOnPlayer(target: NearbyPlayer \| string \| RegExp, spellComponent: number \| string, timeout: number = 3000): Promise<CastSpellResult>` | Cast a combat spell on another player (OPPLAYERT). Prefer {@link castSpell}. |
180:| `getChat(opts: { limit?: number; types?: readonly number[]; includeSelf?: boolean } = {}): GameMessage[]` | Read recent chat messages. Returns player chat (public + PMs) by default, newest last. Reads from the SDK's accumulated history — up to 500 messages retained since connect — so old lines survive both system spam (level-ups, combat) and the client's own 100-deep ring eviction. |
265:| `async sendInteractPlayer(playerIndex: number, option: number = 2): Promise<ActionResult>` | Interact with a player by index and option (1-5). Option 2 = Attack (wilderness), 3 = Follow, 4 = Trade. |
291:| `async sendSetCombatStyle(style: number): Promise<ActionResult>` | Set combat style (0-3). |

Alpha is still alive and fighting at the deadline (about 17:56Z, cutoff 17:57:07Z). I did not get the kill notes into `bots/_team/notes.md`: my append failed on a shell quoting error, and there was no time left to retry.

**Alpha's kills this session (by name):** Man, Rat, Giant rat, Woman, Goblin, Imp. Alpha is at combat level 31 (Attack 61, HP 46) with a bronze sword and wooden shield equipped.

**Problems:**
- Alpha died about eight times, and each death dropped the equipped sword and shield, so I had to re-equip them. Most of the time was spent unarmed.
- Sheep and Chicken were nearby but out of reach during the last run, so I did not kill them. Cow was never found.
- Bravo's chat suggested splitting targets as rats, men, goblins, cows, and chickens/sheep. Bravo's combat level was 29 at last check, so Bravo is probably also killing enemies.
